# AcceptLanguage v0.1.0 - Table of Contents

Parser for Accept-Language request HTTP header

## Modules

- [AcceptLanguage](https://accept-language.hexdocs.pm/AcceptLanguage.md): A lightweight, zero-dependency Elixir library for parsing the `Accept-Language`
HTTP header field as defined in RFC 7231 Section 5.3.5, with full support for
BCP 47 language tags.
